name: Mingles Router
description: Open-source Gonka router with a free key in thirty seconds and a weekly cap.
overview: Mingles Router is an open-source router (github.com/MinglesAI/gonka-proxy) in front of Gonka-served open models, at router.mingles.ai/v1 in the OpenAI shape. A free key is issued in about thirty seconds with no card and no KYC, and the free tier is reported at up to 4 million tokens per week — enough that the site's own users describe an evening of coding work without hitting it. Paid top-ups take card or crypto, and per-client keys with limits are available for agencies.
free_access: Free key in 30 seconds, no card and no KYC
Up to 4M tokens per week on the free tier
Router source is published under a permissive licence
notes: The 4M/week figure comes from Gonka's own list of community brokers rather than the router's homepage, which says only that free-tier limits "last surprisingly long". Small operator.
